name: Westfield Century City
summary: Westfield Century City is a premier open-air luxury shopping destination in West Los Angeles featuring upscale anchors like Bloomingdale's and Nordstrom, alongside high-end retailers, acclaimed restaurants including Eataly and Momofuku, and entertainment venues. The center offers a sophisticated lifestyle experience with modern amenities, EV charging, and year-round events that attract affluent shoppers from across the region.
demographics: Westfield Century City attracts an affluent, cosmopolitan demographic primarily consisting of upper-income professionals, entertainment industry executives, and luxury shoppers from the surrounding West Los Angeles neighborhoods including Beverly Hills, Bel Air, and Westwood. The trade area serves a highly educated population with household incomes significantly above the national average, drawing visitors aged 25-65 who seek premium shopping experiences and upscale dining options. The center's proximity to major entertainment studios and creative agencies brings a fashion-forward clientele with sophisticated tastes and strong purchasing power. Typical visitors include dual-income households without children and affluent families who prioritize quality, brand recognition, and experiential retail over value-oriented shopping.
description: Westfield Century City stands as one of Los Angeles's premier luxury shopping destinations, offering an exceptional open-air retail experience in the heart of West LA. This upscale regional mall features an impressive collection of high-end retailers including Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom, Tiffany & Co., and Alo Yoga, alongside contemporary fashion brands like Aritzia, Princess Polly, and UNIQLO. The center has evolved into a lifestyle destination that seamlessly blends world-class shopping with exceptional dining experiences, featuring renowned restaurants such as Eataly (spanning levels 2 & 3), Katsuya, Super Peach by Momofuku, and Casa Dani. Entertainment options abound with an AMC Theatres complex, American Girl store experiences, and unique attractions like the Gabby's Dollhouse x CAMP interactive experience and Little Kitchen Academy. The center prioritizes modern amenities including electric vehicle charging stations via ChargePoint, free Wi-Fi throughout the property, and convenient package check lockers, while hosting engaging community events ranging from trunk shows and art installations to seasonal celebrations and brand activations.
